height.$description: control.size.sm — 16px box edge for a square control's own dimension: a checkbox square or a radio circle (density: comfortable). A square control reads this on both axes. A switch's track is not square and reads `track`/`width` instead.

width.$description: control.size.sm width — 48px track width for a two-position control, i.e. a switch (2x the 24px `track` height, the common 2:1 track ratio). A square control uses `height` on both axes and does not read this.

dot.$description: control.size.sm dot — 12px inner mark for a radio's dot (0.7 × the 16px box edge by the brand's radio dot setting, snapped to 2px and inside the 2px ring, leaving a 2px gap to the boundary). A control whose mark is a glyph draws it full-bleed at `height`; a switch's traveling thumb reads `thumb` instead.

inset.$description: control.size.sm inset — 3px gap between the thumb and the track's boundary ((24px track − 18px thumb) ÷ 2). Read as a track's uniform padding by a control whose mark travels, i.e. a switch's thumb, so the thumb clears the track's ends at both extremes instead of sitting flush. A control whose mark is centered and static does not read it.

track.$description: control.size.sm track — 24px track height for a switch (density: comfortable). The switch's own cross-axis edge, larger than the 16px square-control `height` because a track holds a traveling thumb. A checkbox/radio does not read it.

thumb.$description: control.size.sm thumb — 18px traveling thumb for a switch (0.75 × the 24px `track`). Larger than a radio's `dot` because the switch's mark is the moving element the eye tracks. A checkbox/radio does not read it.

radius.$description: control.size.sm radius — 2px corner on the 16px box edge (min of radius.sm 2px and one eighth of the box, 16px ÷ 8, snapped to the 2px radius sub-grid). Clamped to the box rather than taken from the radius ramp: a fixed-size control does not scale its corner the way a card does.

line-box.$description: control.size.sm line-box — 21px, the height of one line of the `body.sm` label (font size × line height). A selection control sits in a box this tall and centers within it, so it tracks the first line of a wrapping label instead of floating mid-paragraph.

label-inset.$description: control.size.sm label-inset — 0px, how far an option row's label starts below the top of its control cell: half of the 16px box less the 18px `body.xs` line, and 0 when the line is the taller. Keeps the label's first line centered on the box when the box outgrows the line.
